item.title: Seafarers Happiness Index shows small improvement
item.description: The latest Seafarers Happiness Index (SHI) from The Mission to Seafarers shows a modest improvement in wellbeing at the end of a volatile year, with the overall happiness score rising to 7.26 out of 10 in Q4 2025, up from 7.05 in the previous quarter. item.title: United States emerged as largest 2025 trading partner of Port of Antwerp-Bruges
item.description: Geopolitical tensions, economic uncertainty, and industrial action weighed on the activities of Port of Antwerp-Bruges in 2025.
